pork_oil_dole.name: Meat and Oil Dole
pork_oil_dole.observation: The town dole now hands out pork, oil and wine beside the bread, and the poorest eat fat through the winter.
pork_oil_dole.social_consequence: Townsfolk come to expect meat from the ruler's stores, and a lean year's cut is remembered as a broken promise.

maslin_mixed_sowing.name: Mixed Wheat and Rye
maslin_mixed_sowing.observation: Farmers sow wheat and rye together, so a year that kills one still leaves the other standing; in wet summers the rye's black spurs creep into the loaf.

monthly_farm_calendar.name: Farm Calendar Book
monthly_farm_calendar.observation: A book sets down each month's work, when to plough, prune, shear and salt, so a new steward need not guess.

grain_drying_kilns.name: Grain-Drying Kilns
grain_drying_kilns.observation: Damp sheaves are dried over small flue kilns before storing, and the grain no longer sprouts or moulds in the bin, though a careless fire takes the barn.

walled_kitchen_gardens.name: Walled Kitchen Gardens
walled_kitchen_gardens.observation: Pot-herbs, roots and leeks grow inside a sheltering wall by the kitchen door, and the pottage has greens nearly all year.

straw_skep_hives.name: Straw Skep Hives
straw_skep_hives.observation: Coiled straw hives sit in niches in a warm wall; the swarms are taken in autumn for honey and wax, and the orchard sets more fruit.

grain_mould_starters.name: Grain Mould Starters
grain_mould_starters.observation: Steamed grain is left to grow a yellow mould in warm rooms and kept as a starter for brewing and sauces.

farm_encyclopedia.name: Farm Encyclopedia
farm_encyclopedia.observation: One great book gathers what is known of crops, trees, stock, brewing and pickling, and estates copy it for their stewards.

cow_dairying.name: Dairy Cows
cow_dairying.observation: Cows are kept for milk and butter as well as for the plough, and the household eats curds and whey through the summer.

autumn_stock_slaughter.name: Autumn Slaughter
autumn_stock_slaughter.observation: Beasts that cannot be wintered on the hay are killed and salted at the year's turn, and the fodder goes further for those kept.

pressed_tea_cakes.name: Pressed Tea Cakes
pressed_tea_cakes.observation: Tea leaves are steamed, pounded and pressed into hard cakes that keep for years and travel far on the pack road.

irrigated_cane_fields.name: Irrigated Cane
irrigated_cane_fields.observation: Cane is watered from the river channels of the dry valleys and crushed in presses for its sweet juice.
irrigated_cane_fields.social_consequence: Cane needs gangs through the pressing season, and the valley's poor are bound to the mills.

seaweed_manuring.name: Seaweed Manuring
seaweed_manuring.observation: Carts haul wrack and shell sand up from the shore after storms and spread them on the coastal fields.

terraced_rice_paddies.name: Terraced Paddies
terraced_rice_paddies.observation: Hill slopes are cut into flooded steps of rice, each fed from the one above; the still water breeds fevers along the terraces.

teahouse_tea.name: Teahouses
teahouse_tea.observation: Tea is steeped in boiled water and drunk every day; teahouses sell it by the bowl, and fewer fall sick from the ditch water.

northern_slope_vineyards.name: Northern Vineyards
northern_slope_vineyards.observation: Vines are coaxed onto the sheltered south-facing slopes of colder country, and the northern estates press their own wine.

mouldboard_plough.name: Mouldboard Plough
mouldboard_plough.observation: A heavy wheeled plough cuts with coulter and share and turns the sod over with a curved board, drawn by a long team of oxen.
mouldboard_plough.ability_reason: The heavy wet clays of the river plains can be tilled at last: the mouldboard turns and drains the sod, and new land comes under the plough.
mouldboard_plough.social_consequence: An eight-ox team is more than one household owns; neighbours must plough together or hire from those who can.

hop_gardens.name: Hop Gardens
hop_gardens.observation: Hops climb tall poles in tended gardens; brewers find that ale with hops in it keeps sweet longer.

malting_floor_brewhouses.name: Malting Brewhouses
malting_floor_brewhouses.observation: Estate brewhouses steep barley, turn it on a malting floor and dry it in a kiln, brewing ale for every mouth on the estate.

mould_brewed_rice_wine.name: Rice Wine
mould_brewed_rice_wine.observation: Rice is brewed with the grain mould starter into a clear strong wine for feasts and offerings.

dearth_price_ceilings.name: Dearth Price Ceilings
dearth_price_ceilings.observation: In a failed year the town forbids grain to leave its district and posts the most a measure may cost.
dearth_price_ceilings.ability_reason: When the harvest fails, the town can stop grain leaving and cap its price, and the poor eat through the lean months.
dearth_price_ceilings.social_consequence: Grain dealers hoard and smuggle against the posted price; a market warden now stands in the square beside the price board.

three_field_rotation.name: Three-Field Rotation
three_field_rotation.observation: The village land lies in three great fields: one in winter grain, one in spring grain and one resting, turned in order year by year.
three_field_rotation.ability_reason: Only a third of the land rests instead of half, and a failure in one season is carried by the grain of the other.
three_field_rotation.social_consequence: The village decides together what every strip will bear; a man who sows out of turn wrongs all his neighbours.

ridge_furrow_strips.name: Ridge and Furrow
ridge_furrow_strips.observation: Ploughmen throw the soil toward the middle of each strip, so the heavy clay sheds its water into the furrows between.

spring_field_legumes.name: Spring Legumes
spring_field_legumes.observation: Peas, beans and vetch go into the spring field; the pot thickens with pulse and the next wheat stands taller.

citrus_orchards.name: Citrus Orchards
citrus_orchards.observation: Oranges, lemons and citrons are grown in watered walled orchards, their sour juice prized in sauces and sickrooms.

new_garden_vegetables.name: New Garden Vegetables
new_garden_vegetables.observation: Spinach, aubergine and artichoke come to the watered gardens from far lands and spread from kitchen to kitchen.

saffron_fields.name: Saffron Fields
saffron_fields.observation: Fields of crocus are picked by hand at dawn for the red threads, worth their weight in silver as spice and dye.

dryland_rice_basins.name: Dry-Land Rice Basins
dryland_rice_basins.observation: Rice is grown in walled basins flooded from canals in hot dry country; the ground whitens with salt where the water stands too long.

stockfish_drying.name: Stockfish
stockfish_drying.observation: Cod and ling are hung unsalted on racks in the cold sea wind until they are hard as boards, and keep for years.

spiked_harrow.name: Spiked Harrow
spiked_harrow.observation: A wooden frame set with spikes is dragged over the sown field, breaking clods and covering the seed from the birds.

village_bake_ovens.name: Common Bake-Ovens
village_bake_ovens.observation: Each household brings its dough to the one great village oven and pays the oven-keeper a loaf for the baking.
village_bake_ovens.social_consequence: The lord's oven is the only lawful oven; a household caught baking at home is fined.

paddy_chain_pumps.name: Paddy Chain Pumps
paddy_chain_pumps.observation: Men tread a wheel that drags a chain of paddles up a trough, lifting water from the stream onto the paddy steps.

dried_fruit_trade.name: Dried Fruit Trade
dried_fruit_trade.observation: Raisins, figs and dates are dried in the sun and sold by the basket along the trade roads.

early_ripening_rice.name: Early-Ripening Rice
early_ripening_rice.observation: A new rice ripens in sixty days and stands through drought, so paddies bear twice a year and dry uplands can be planted.
early_ripening_rice.ability_reason: Two crops a season and drought-hardy upland fields: the rice lands can feed far more people than before.
early_ripening_rice.social_consequence: Crowded rice valleys grow faster than their towns can govern; a failed second crop now falls on many more mouths.

offshore_cod_fishing.name: Offshore Cod Fishing
offshore_cod_fishing.observation: Open boats sail out of sight of land to the deep banks and come back loaded with cod; some do not come back.

soy_sauce_drawing.name: Bean Sauce
soy_sauce_drawing.observation: The dark salty liquor pressed from fermented bean paste is drawn off and sold as a sauce of its own.

terraced_tea_gardens.name: Terraced Tea Gardens
terraced_tea_gardens.observation: Tea bushes are planted on terraced hillsides in rows, and pickers work the slopes from spring to autumn.

refined_loaf_sugar.name: Loaf Sugar
refined_loaf_sugar.observation: Cane juice is boiled again and again and poured into clay cones, drying into hard white loaves of sugar.

horse_ploughing.name: Horse Ploughing
horse_ploughing.observation: Collared, shod horses draw the plough and harrow in place of oxen, and the spring work is done in fewer days.
horse_ploughing.ability_reason: A horse ploughs half again as fast as an ox; with collar and shoes it can till, harrow and cart within the short spring window.
horse_ploughing.social_consequence: Horses eat oats, not grass alone; a field of every farm now goes to feeding the team.

sugar_candied_fruit.name: Candied Fruit
sugar_candied_fruit.observation: Fruit and peel are boiled in sugar syrup until they keep through the year in jars.

stew_pond_fisheries.name: Stew Ponds
stew_pond_fisheries.observation: Estates and religious houses stock dammed ponds with fish for the fast days, draining and restocking them in turn.

graded_bread_loaves.name: Graded Loaves
graded_bread_loaves.observation: Bakers sell three breads at set prices: white, wholemeal and the coarse loaf of bran and rye.
graded_bread_loaves.social_consequence: White bread marks the table of the great and coarse bread the servant's; a person's rank is known by the loaf.

coney_warrens.name: Coney Warrens
coney_warrens.observation: Rabbits are bred in banked warrens on sandy heath for meat and fur, and a warrener guards them from poachers.
coney_warrens.social_consequence: Escaped rabbits eat the villagers' corn, and the lord's warren is a grievance in every nearby parish.

heavy_draught_breeding.name: Heavy Draught Horses
heavy_draught_breeding.observation: Breeders keep their heaviest mares and stallions for the plough and cart, and the teams grow broader year on year.

dried_durum_pasta.name: Dried Pasta
dried_durum_pasta.observation: Hard-wheat dough is cut into strands and dried in the sun, and sacks of it are carried on ships and caravans.

great_aisled_barns.name: Great Aisled Barns
great_aisled_barns.observation: Barns as long as a church, with aisles of great timber posts, hold the estate's grain and the tenants' dues.
great_aisled_barns.social_consequence: The great barn is where the lord's share is counted; the reeve keeps the tally at its doors.

irrigated_husbandry_treatise.name: Dry-Land Husbandry Treatise
irrigated_husbandry_treatise.observation: A treatise sets out grafting, watering by the calendar and the kinds of soil, from long trials in watered gardens.

cider_perry_pressing.name: Cider and Perry
cider_perry_pressing.observation: Orchard apples and pears are milled and pressed, and the juice ferments in casks into cider and perry.

verjuice_sauces.name: Verjuice
verjuice_sauces.observation: The juice of unripe grapes is pressed and kept in casks to sharpen sauces where lemons do not grow.

estate_vaccaries.name: Estate Dairy Farms
estate_vaccaries.observation: Estate dairy farms run herds of milk cows with a cheese room and a dairy keeper who answers to the steward.

estate_yield_accounts.name: Yield Accounts
estate_yield_accounts.observation: Stewards write down the seed sown and the grain reaped on every field, and can say which land repays its seed.
estate_yield_accounts.social_consequence: A reeve's written account now stands against the tenant's word; the estate knows exactly what it can demand.

keg_salted_butter.name: Keg Butter
keg_salted_butter.observation: Butter is worked with salt and packed hard into small kegs for sale in the towns months later.

bread_weight_assize.name: Bread Assize
bread_weight_assize.observation: A posted table fixes the weight of each loaf by the price of grain, and wardens weigh the bakers' bread.
bread_weight_assize.ability_reason: A penny now buys what it should in dear years and cheap, and the poor are not starved by short-weight bakers.
bread_weight_assize.social_consequence: Bakers who sell short are fined or pilloried; the bread warden's scale is feared in every bakehouse.

long_aged_hard_cheese.name: Aged Hard Cheese
long_aged_hard_cheese.observation: Great wheels of pressed cheese are rubbed with salt and turned on cellar shelves for years before they are cut.

grafted_tree_nurseries.name: Tree Nurseries
grafted_tree_nurseries.observation: Nurserymen sell young trees already grafted with named fruit, and new orchards bear true.

imported_spice_blends.name: Spice Blends
imported_spice_blends.observation: Great kitchens blend pepper, ginger and cinnamon brought by caravan and ship, and the spice ships bring sickness with them.
imported_spice_blends.social_consequence: Pepper on the lord's table is a boast of rank, and the silver to buy it leaves the realm.

hopped_export_beer.name: Hopped Beer
hopped_export_beer.observation: Heavily hopped beer keeps for months in the cask and is shipped across the sea to distant ports.

distilled_spirits.name: Distilled Spirits
distilled_spirits.observation: Wine and fermented grain are boiled in the still, and the burning water that drips from it keeps forever.
distilled_spirits.ability_reason: A spirit that keeps forever and travels in small casks: physicians prize it and taverns sell it.
distilled_spirits.social_consequence: Strong water loosens tongues and fists; brawls and drunken deaths rise wherever it is cheap.

ale_taster_licensing.name: Licensed Alehouses
ale_taster_licensing.observation: Alehouses must be licensed, and a sworn taster tries every brewing before it is sold.
ale_taster_licensing.social_consequence: The licensed alehouse hangs its sign and the unlicensed are closed; the ale-taster is a petty office men compete for.

protected_drove_routes.name: Drove Routes
protected_drove_routes.observation: Flocks walk between summer and winter grazing along wide protected routes that no farmer may plough.
protected_drove_routes.social_consequence: Farmers along the routes see their crops grazed and their fences broken, and the herders' guild wins every quarrel.

barreled_salt_meat.name: Barrelled Salt Meat
barreled_salt_meat.observation: Beef and pork are packed in brine in tight barrels for ships and garrisons; men who live on it for months grow sore-gummed.

almond_milk_fast_food.name: Fast-Day Kitchen
almond_milk_fast_food.observation: Cooks make milk from pounded almonds and pies of fish for the fast days when meat and dairy are forbidden.

measured_court_recipes.name: Court Recipe Books
measured_court_recipes.observation: The master cook of the court keeps a book of recipes with every measure written, and the kitchen follows it.

sugar_confectionery.name: Confectionery
sugar_confectionery.observation: Almond paste and boiled sugar are shaped into fruits, beasts and castles for the high table at feasts.

illustrated_farm_treatise.name: Illustrated Farm Treatise
illustrated_farm_treatise.observation: A farm treatise with drawings of every tool and machine lets a steward build what he has only read about.

raised_pie_crusts.name: Raised Pies
raised_pie_crusts.observation: Thick pastry cases are raised by hand, filled with meat and sealed, and carried to market whole.

buckwheat_cultivation.name: Buckwheat
buckwheat_cultivation.observation: Buckwheat is sown on sour and newly broken ground where wheat will not thrive, and it ripens in a short summer.

barrel_gutted_herring.name: Barrelled Herring
barrel_gutted_herring.observation: Herring are gutted on deck the day they are caught and packed in brine barrels, and whole fleets follow the shoals.

cattle_droving.name: Cattle Droving
cattle_droving.observation: Drovers walk herds for weeks from the grazing lands to the town markets, and cattle sickness walks with them.

dredge_mixed_grain.name: Dredge Corn
dredge_mixed_grain.observation: Oats and barley are sown mixed as dredge, a spring crop that seldom fails entirely.

town_dearth_granaries.name: Town Dearth Granaries
town_dearth_granaries.observation: The town buys grain in cheap years and keeps its own granary full, selling at cost when the harvest fails.
town_dearth_granaries.ability_reason: The town holds a year's bread against dearth, and famine no longer empties the streets.
town_dearth_granaries.social_consequence: A grain master now sits beside the seat of rule; failing to open the granary in a hard spring is cause for riot.

smoked_red_herring.name: Red Herring
smoked_red_herring.observation: Salted herring are hung in smokehouses for weeks until they turn red and hard, keeping for months.
